body:
This had the potential to be serious, but thankfully the fix is simple and effective (and included in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/14123). Under the hood, things make a lot more sense now.
The problem was that we hadn't considered the fact that the same interface could be used for different method of the top-level interface. 

Thanks for reporting!
Lovely!!! Will try 1.11.RC1  with #14123 as soon as it is out,  since I am stuck right now ...

@geoand unfortunately I still see issues here with 1.11.RC1. Take a look at the attached reproducible project
[issue14113-new.zip](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/5818878/issue14113-new.zip)

I added Version nested configuration and data for it in the application.yml. I expected to read that data , but instead - got the defaults from the Version interface???

Run Main and you will see in the output console:

```major: 15, minor: 0```

instead of:

```major: 16, minor: 0```

I'll have a look later on.

This might be a different issue, so I'll hold off from reopening for now

I took a look and if I am not mistaked, the problem lies in your configuration, not the way Quarkus handles it.
In your YAML you have:

```
sql_proxy:
  server:
      version:
        major:16
        minor:0
```

which is wrong because there is no whitespace between `major:` and `16`. If you add a whitespace, then everything works as expected.
ouch ... you are correct! The traps of YAML
I personally dislike YAML very much...
Do you have an example I can use to test this?
See #14847. @radcortez is well aware of the issues, we discussed them on the zulip chat, I provided examples there
